test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is: **citizens.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"citizens"** refers to individuals who are legally recognized members of a state or nation, either by birth or naturalization. (नागरिक)

 
 
• **Example: **As citizens, we have the right to vote and participate in the democratic process.
 
 
 
• The context tells us that citizens have the right to take part in the decision-making process in a democratic society.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Lawyers** (वकील): Professionals who practice law and provide legal advice and representation to clients.

 
 
• **Example:** The lawyers argued their case passionately in front of the judge.
 
 
 
• **Humans** (मानव): Members of the species Homo sapiens, characterized by their ability to think, communicate, and create.
 
 
• **Example:** Humans have the unique ability to use language to communicate complex ideas.
 
 
 
• **Politicians** (राजनेता): Individuals who are involved in politics, especially as elected representatives.
 
 
• **Example:** The politicians debated the new policy in parliament.
